annotations.title: Verify this server can reach Eventbrite

description: Reports which hop is broken when a real tool fails. With EVENTBRITE_TOKEN set: Resolves the credential the way real tools do, then makes one authenticated request to www.eventbriteapi.com. Reports which source supplied the credential, whether www.eventbriteapi.com accepted it, the round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'no credential' from 'credential rejected' from 'a www.eventbriteapi.com-side problem'. Read-only; never returns the credential itself. Without a token, discovery falls back to your signed-in browser tab, so it round-trips /api/v3/categories/ on www.eventbrite.com through that bridge instead and says the token is missing. Every failure carries an error.kind — e.g. 'credential_rejected', 'edge_blocked' (a CDN/WAF refused the request; the token was never judged), 'no_credential', 'timeout', 'http', 'transport'.
